name: 2027 plan changes (ES): carrier-exit + renewal pages, WhatsApp shares, Spanish media
demand_trigger: 2027 discontinuation letters (Cigna, Molina, Sunshine leaving) and renewal increases (avg +15.9% proposed; Florida Blue PPO ~+26%)
content_concept: 5 dated Spanish pages (hub + Molina, Cigna, Sunshine→Ambetter, Florida Blue) with FAQ schema and a WhatsApp share button; 4 WhatsApp/IG share cards; tagged links for Bubba's IG story (?c=ig-story) and Spanish media pitches (?c=media)
offer_cta: ¿Te llegó una carta de tu plan 2027? Revisa qué hacer antes del 15 de diciembre (chequeo gratis de 60 segundos).
hypothesis: People holding a discontinuation or renewal letter search the insurer's name in Spanish; dated, specific pages capture them with almost no competition, and the 'keep your doctors' problem makes the phone step natural.

name: 2027 plan changes (EN): carrier-exit + Florida Blue renewal pages
content_concept: 5 dated English pages (hub + Molina, Cigna, Sunshine→Ambetter, Florida Blue) + share cards
offer_cta: Got a 2027 letter from your plan? Check what to do before Dec 15 (free, 60 seconds).
hypothesis: Same as X016 in English; tests whether English insurer-name searches are as underserved as Spanish.

name: Job-loss engine: WARN-triggered employer pages + Florida layoff hub
demand_trigger: Loss of employer coverage (60-day SEP); COBRA price shock
content_concept: Hub + one page per WARN layoff (company-level public data; 7 live), each with the 60-day window computed from the effective date; Spanish companion page; WARN watcher drafts new pages
offer_cta: Laid off from <Company>? See your 60-day options (free, 60 seconds).
hypothesis: Workers search their own employer's layoff; employer-specific pages with their deadline outrank news for health-coverage intent and convert at the moment the SEP opens.

name: 'Is Open Enrollment still open?' live page (EN/ES)
demand_trigger: People who think enrollment ended Dec 15 (misreported dates); last weeks of OEP
content_concept: A page whose answer changes with the date (opens Nov 1 / open until Dec 15 / STILL open until Jan 15 / closed) with a countdown
offer_cta: No, it's not too late: enroll by Jan 15. / No se te pasó: inscríbete antes del 15 de enero.
hypothesis: Late-season searchers who believe they missed the deadline are high-intent and nearly unserved after Dec 15.
